## CrowdStrike rises 13.8% after raising full-year revenue guidance on AI security demand

A guidance raise paired with a 13.8% move indicates the market is assigning genuine forward credibility to CRWD's AI security revenue thesis. This is a positive read-through for AI-adjacent security platforms with recurring-revenue models and recovering trust narratives.

- CRWD shares rose 13.8% after the company beat earnings and raised full-year revenue guidance.
- Management cited AI security demand as the driver of the guidance revision.
- The move signals the market is re-rating CRWD's forward revenue trajectory, not merely clearing a low bar.
- Reinforces a constructive cybersecurity demand environment tied to enterprise AI adoption.
